recent_events.title: Federal government approves $673 million to keep Canada Post afloat
recent_events.description: The Canadian government approved up to $673 million in repayable funding through a cabinet order to help Canada Post meet its operating and income demands through March 2027, alongside a $1.034 billion loan for fiscal year 2025-26

recent_events.title: Canada Post releases 2025 annual report showing record $1.57 billion loss
recent_events.description: Canada Post reported an unprecedented pre-tax loss of $1.57 billion in 2025, a 46% increase from the previous year's $841 million loss. CEO Doug Ettinger announced plans to cut 30,000 jobs over the next decade through retirement and voluntary departures

recent_events.title: Canada Post begins multi-year transformation with community mailbox conversion
recent_events.description: Canada Post announced preliminary work on transforming delivery services, starting with converting 136,000 addresses in 13 communities from door-to-door delivery to community mailboxes, as part of a five-year national conversion plan affecting approximately four million addresses

recent_events.title: Canada Post announces transformation plan consultations with unions
recent_events.description: Canada Post announced it received government approval to begin consultations with bargaining units including CUPW on plans to transform the postal service, including converting door-to-door addresses to community mailboxes and modernizing delivery operations

recent_events.title: Canada Post and CUPW reach tentative five-year agreement ending strike
recent_events.description: After a 58-day labour disruption (national strike from Sep 25 to Oct 10, then rotating strikes until Nov 21), Canada Post and the Canadian Union of Postal Workers reached a tentative five-year contract agreement, averting holiday season disruption

recent_events.title: Canada Post submits transformation plan to government
recent_events.description: Canada Post submitted its long-awaited overhaul plan to the federal government, detailing measures to modernize the postal service and restore financial sustainability while maintaining essential services for Canadians

recent_events.title: Government orders Canada Post transformation; CUPW launches nationwide strike
recent_events.description: Minister Joel Lightbound announced major reforms: ending door-to-door delivery for 4 million addresses, lifting moratorium on rural post office closures, allowing ground transport for non-urgent mail. CUPW responded by launching an immediate nationwide strike

recent_events.title: CIRB orders Canada Post workers back to work ending 32-day national strike
recent_events.description: The Canada Industrial Relations Board ordered postal workers back to work after a 32-day national strike that began November 15, 2024. The strike created a 30-day backlog of mail and parcels, costing Canada Post approximately $270 million in losses for 2024

core_business: 加拿大邮政（Canada Post Corporation）是加拿大的国家邮政运营商，成立于1867年，前身为加拿大皇家邮政（Royal Mail Canada）。1981年根据《加拿大邮政公司法》转型为皇家公司（Crown Corporation），成为自主经营、自负盈亏的国有企业。加拿大邮政服务覆盖超过1600万个地址，拥有约6200个邮局（包括公司直营和零售加盟），员工总数约6.2万人。其主要业务分为三大板块：信件邮件（Transaction Mail）服务，包括国内国际信件投递，年收入受数字化冲击从2006年的55亿件下降至2023年的约20亿件；包裹快递（Parcels）服务，受益于电子商务增长，包裹收入从2015年的16亿加元增长至2023年的34亿加元，但市场份额从2019年的62%下降至2023年的23%；直邮营销（Direct Marketing）服务。此外，加拿大邮政持有快递公司Purolator 91%的股份。2018年至2025年间，加拿大邮政累计亏损超过53亿加元，2025年税前亏损创纪录达15.7亿加元。公司目前正实施大规模转型计划，包括逐步取消上门投递改为社区邮箱、优化农村邮局网络、推动非紧急邮件由空运转陆运等措施。
apec_stance: 加拿大邮政作为加拿大的国家邮政运营商，是万国邮政联盟（UPU）的成员，通过国际邮政网络与亚太地区各经济体保持邮政业务往来。在亚太经合组织（APEC）框架下，加拿大邮政参与跨境电子商务物流和邮政服务现代化讨论。随着电子商务的全球化发展，加拿大邮政与亚太地区国家的跨境包裹投递量持续增长。然而，加拿大邮政近年来面临严重的财务危机和市场份额流失，其转型计划将深刻影响加拿大与APEC经济体之间的跨境物流服务质量和时效性。加拿大政府于2025年9月和2026年5月分别向加拿大邮政注资超10亿加元和6.73亿加元，以维持这一关键基础设施的运营。
